name: rex-inbox
title: Rex Inbox
description: A T3 Code–style inbox for Rex panes: pin, inbox, working, snoozed, and settled, driven by the Program Status Protocol (OSC 7501).
author: xheisenbugx

commands.name: inbox
commands.title: Rex Inbox
commands.subtitle: Rex
commands.description: Triage Rex panes that report a program status: pinned, inbox, working, snoozed, and settled.

preferences.name: shortcutSettle
preferences.title: Shortcut: Settle
preferences.description: Key combo for “Settle”, such as cmd+e or ⌘⇧P. Modifiers: cmd, ctrl, opt, shift. Type “none” to remove it.

preferences.name: shortcutMoveToInbox
preferences.title: Shortcut: Move to Inbox
preferences.description: Key combo for “Move to Inbox”, such as cmd+i or ⌘⇧P. Modifiers: cmd, ctrl, opt, shift. Type “none” to remove it.

preferences.name: shortcutPin
preferences.title: Shortcut: Pin / Unpin
preferences.description: Key combo for “Pin / Unpin”, such as cmd+shift+p or ⌘⇧P. Modifiers: cmd, ctrl, opt, shift. Type “none” to remove it.

preferences.name: shortcutSnooze
preferences.title: Shortcut: Snooze
preferences.description: Key combo for “Snooze”, such as cmd+s or ⌘⇧P. Modifiers: cmd, ctrl, opt, shift. Type “none” to remove it.

preferences.name: shortcutUnsnooze
preferences.title: Shortcut: Unsnooze
preferences.description: Key combo for “Unsnooze”, such as opt+cmd+s or ⌘⇧P. Modifiers: cmd, ctrl, opt, shift. Type “none” to remove it.

preferences.name: shortcutShowOutput
preferences.title: Shortcut: Show Output
preferences.description: Key combo for “Show Output”, such as cmd+o or ⌘⇧P. Modifiers: cmd, ctrl, opt, shift. Type “none” to remove it.

preferences.name: shortcutRefresh
preferences.title: Shortcut: Refresh
preferences.description: Key combo for “Refresh”, such as cmd+r or ⌘⇧P. Modifiers: cmd, ctrl, opt, shift. Type “none” to remove it.

preferences.name: shortcutCopyPath
preferences.title: Shortcut: Copy Folder Path
preferences.description: Key combo for “Copy Folder Path”, such as cmd+shift+. or ⌘⇧P. Modifiers: cmd, ctrl, opt, shift. Type “none” to remove it.

preferences.name: shortcutCopyPaneId
preferences.title: Shortcut: Copy Rex Pane ID
preferences.description: Key combo for “Copy Rex Pane ID”, such as cmd+shift+c or ⌘⇧P. Modifiers: cmd, ctrl, opt, shift. Type “none” to remove it.

commands.name: menu-bar
commands.title: Rex Inbox Menu Bar
commands.subtitle: Rex
commands.description: Show how many Rex panes need you, and jump to them, from the menu bar.

preferences.name: rexPath
preferences.title: Rex CLI Path
preferences.description: Absolute path to the rex binary. Leave empty to auto-detect.

preferences.name: client
preferences.title: Rex Client
preferences.description: Label or ID of the Rex app to drive when opening a pane. Leave empty to use the first connected app.

preferences.name: autoSettleHours
preferences.title: Auto-Settle After (Hours)
preferences.description: Finished or idle panes with no new activity for this many hours move to Settled. Use 0 to only settle manually.

preferences.name: settleOnOpen
preferences.title: Settle on Open
preferences.label: Settle a finished pane when you open it
preferences.description: Opening a done or idle pane marks it as seen, so it leaves the inbox.

preferences.name: wakeOnBlocked
preferences.title: Wake Snoozed on Blocked
preferences.label: Bring snoozed panes back when they need input
preferences.description: A snoozed pane returns to the inbox early if it becomes blocked or fails.

preferences.name: includeIdle
preferences.title: Include Idle Panes
preferences.label: Show panes whose only status is idle
preferences.description: When off, panes whose program only reports idle are hidden.
